g.text: A fixed physical length becomes electrically longer as frequency increases

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Illustrative length-to-wavelength comparison, not a universal cutoff. A λ/10 guideline permits 36° phase variation and may be too loose for precise
analysis. Fast digital edges contain frequencies well above the repetition rate; return-path geometry and rise time also matter.
